layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing, magazine-like structured layout, mobile-first design.

components.buttons: Shadcn Button heavily customized. Primary: bg-[#E07A5F] text-white hover:bg-[#C96B52] shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(224,122,95,0.3)]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E07A5F] text-[#E07A5F] hover:bg-[#E07A5F]/10.
components.cards: Cardless or subtle surfaces. Background #FFFFFF, 1px subtle border #E8E6DF, no heavy drop shadow. Use hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all.
components.inputs: Minimalist inputs. bg-[#FAFAF7] border-b-2 border-[#E8E6DF] focus:border-[#E07A5F] rounded-none focus:ring-0 px-0 py-2 text-lg font-sans text-[#2D3047] transition-colors outline-none w-full.
components.chips: Rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1. Detected/Available items: bg-[#81B29A]/15 text-[#3D6A53]. Missing: bg-[#E8E6DF] text-[#5C5F73].
components.navigation: Sticky bottom nav on mobile for app-feel (glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAFAF7]/80 border-t border-[#E8E6DF]). Sticky top nav on desktop.

motion.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) for cards, scale up (scale-105) for images within overflow-hidden containers.
motion.loading: Use an organic pulsing effect or a gentle fade-in skeleton loader.

icons.style: stroke-[1.5] for a lighter, more elegant feel matching the serif typography.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI with an editorial feel. Use a sticky bottom navigation bar or a clean top header reflecting a modern food app.
Import and use 'Cormorant Garamond' for all headings (font-serif) and 'Outfit' for all body text (font-sans).
The hero section should have 'Take fridge photo' as a prominent primary CTA button and 'Add ingredients manually' as a secondary button.
When displaying ingredients, use the chip style. Color code available ingredients in Sage Green (#81B29A) and missing ingredients in neutral Grey (#E8E6DF).
Implement the recipe card as a highly visual, borderless card with large imagery, time, and difficulty badges.
Ensure the layout feels 'editorial'—use negative space well and avoid cramming elements.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='take-photo-btn', data-testid='recipe-card') for robust automated testing.
